subject: Re: Redwood security packet & next steps
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Cole <dana@greenstack.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-20T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood — quick recap + security packet

Hi Dana,

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciated the candid overview of GreenStack's latency and tenant isolation needs. Quick recap and next steps from my side: 

- Redwood fit: predictable inference latency (<150ms p95 target) and dedicated pools per tenant for isolation.
- Engineering ask: sample inference load (1k qps burst, avg 300 qps) + expected sequence lengths so we can size a Dedicated pool recommendation.
- Security/compliance: you asked for our SOC 2 / security packet; attached is the packet and a short SOC2 summary.

Attachments: Redwood_Security_Packet_2026.pdf, SOC2-Report-Redwood-2025-summary.txt

Next steps I propose:
1) You and your infra lead take a look at the packet this week.
2) If there are any questions, we'll set up a 30-min call with our security engineer (CC'ing Laura for scheduling).
3) We will prepare a Dedicated sizing proposal based on the load you share.

If the packet looks fine, when would be a good time for a short call with your infra/security folks?

Best,
Alex
Alex Martinez | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Dana Cole <dana@greenstack.io>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-21T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood — quick recap + security packet

Thanks, Alex — received the packet and skimmed the SOC 2 summary. Sharing with our security lead (it@greenstack.io) and procurement. We should have initial feedback early next week.

Two quick Qs for your team:
1) Do you have an expected retention policy for inference logs by default?
2) Is there a way to host the control plane in our VPC for Private deployments (we may need that for regulated customers).

I'll loop in our security lead if needed.

—Dana
Head of Platform, GreenStack
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Cole <dana@greenstack.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, GreenStack IT Team <it@greenstack.io>, procurement@greenstack.io
Date: 2026-05-28T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood — quick recap + security packet

Hi Dana — just checking in on the security packet and your two questions. Quick answers below in case it's helpful before you get to internal review: 

- Retention: Default platform logs are retained for 30 days; we offer configurable retention windows up to 1 year (add-on) and can provide token-level redaction.
- Private control plane: Yes — Redwood Private supports VPC-hosted control plane and on-prem options. We commonly combine VPC control plane with customer-managed KMS for keys.

If you want, we can put together a short diagram and a one-page note on retention options and KMS integrations. Laura (cc) can join a call next week with your security lead.

If I don't hear back, I'll follow up again mid-next week — just want to make sure there are no blockers on your side.

Best,
Alex
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Cole <dana@greenstack.io>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-05T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Checking priority on Redwood security packet — quick assist

Hi Dana — Laura here from Redwood (Alex's manager). Alex mentioned you were reviewing our security materials for the GreenStack evaluation. I wanted to check if anything is blocking your review or if we'd help by:

- Scheduling a 30-min technical call with our security engineer to walk through SOC 2 controls and network architecture,
- Sharing a VPC/network diagram and KMS integration notes (one-pager),
- Providing a redlines-ready data processing addendum for procurement.

We know timelines shift — if this isn't a priority right now, a quick reply with an updated timeframe would help us plan appropriately. Alternatively, if you're ready to move forward, we can start a Dedicated sizing draft this week.

Thanks for the time — happy to be flexible on timing.

Regards,
Laura Bennett | Sales Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference
